03 / RESEARCH

Research experience

YEAR – PRESENT

Graduate Researcher

[Department / Research Group]

[University or Research Institution]

Research interests include relativistic hydrodynamics, finite-temperature field theory, and the microscopic foundations of transport phenomena in strongly interacting matter.

  • Investigating theoretical questions related to relativistic fluid dynamics and its possible extensions.
  • Studying mathematical frameworks, conservation laws, constitutive relations, and relevant analytical techniques.
  • Exploring the connections between microscopic quantum dynamics and macroscopic descriptions of strongly interacting matter.
Quantum field theory Relativistic hydrodynamics Analytical research
